description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Vi's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] and ''[[File:Vi Vault Breaker.png|20xpx|border|link=Vi#Vault Breaker|An icon for Vi's ability Vault Breaker]] [[Vi#Vault Breaker|Vault Breaker]]'' apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal '''bonus''' physical damage, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict [[File:Armor penetration icon.svg|15px|link=Armor penetration]] 20% armor reduction for 4 seconds.
description.text: Passive: Vi's basic attacks on-hit and Vault Breaker apply a stack of Denting Blows to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal bonus physical damage, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict  20% armor reduction for 4 seconds.

description2.raw: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.
description2.text: After consuming Denting Blows, Vi gains  bonus attack speed for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.

leveling.raw:
'''Bonus Physical Damage:'''
4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8% (+ 3.5% per 100 '''bonus''' AD) of target's '''maximum''' health
leveling.text: Bonus Physical Damage:4 / 5 / 6 / 7 / 8% (+ 3.5% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health

notes.raw: * The armor penetration will apply after the triggering damage. * The enhanced attack applies other [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects and can both [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] as normal as well as apply [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] [[Life steal|life steal]] (the bonus damage cannot do either). * ''Denting Blows'' can be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] but cannot be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] nor missed while '''Vi''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * The attacks do not affect [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]] nor [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]].
notes.text:
The armor penetration will apply after the triggering damage.
The enhanced attack applies other on-hit effects and can both critically strike as normal as well as apply  life steal (the bonus damage cannot do either).
Denting Blows can be blocked but cannot be dodged nor missed while Vi is blinded.
The attacks do not affect structures nor wards.
